newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to rise but 109-20 area looks tough.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to rise but 109-20 area looks tough.

text.p: June gilt futures will strengthen on Wednesday and will gain an added boost if they can exceed last week's close at 108-31, but there is difficult resistance looming in the 109-20 area, analysts said.

"There's a reasonably good chance of a small bounce back, after the poor performance yesterday, on the back of the Treasuries going firmer overnight," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
"But I'm still not convincved this is anything but a temporary phenomenon," he said.
June gilts at 0708 GMT were at 108-18, up 7/32 on the day.
The market, with Wednesday's stronger start taking it as high as 108-21, has nearly filled a gap it left from last Thursday's low at 108-22 and Tuesday's 108-19 high.
But analysts have been generally bearish on bonds in the medium to long term, with a gloomy U.S. market leading the way.
"I'm not expecting a rally above the highs of last week at 109-20,21," Cossor said.
Gilts set highs of 109-21 on March 25, 109-18 on March 26 and 109-20 on March 27 before swooping lower.
Juliette Clark, senior treasury manager at Royal Bank of Scotland in London, also saw near-term upside scope.
Clark said in a note to clients that there was retracement resistance at 108-23 and a failure there would keep bears on track.
"However, the descent since the February high has left the momentum indicators tired and there is potential for a firmer tone over the next couple of days," she said.
"Above 108-23 the upward progress should continue to 109-04,06" she said.
